name: io.github.ianderso/gov-gazetteer-mcp
title: GOV Historical Gazetteer
description: German historical gazetteer GOV: a place's name, Kreis, parish and Standesamt in any year.

environmentVariables.name: GOV_GAZETTEER_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk response cache.

environmentVariables.name: GOV_GAZETTEER_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one request.

environmentVariables.name: GOV_GAZETTEER_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between two requests to GOV. Never below 1.

environmentVariables.name: GOV_GAZETTEER_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so CompGen can reach whoever runs the server.
